id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description: The specification used for retrieving image to be displayed.

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

descriptionText.description:
Description / secondary text for none image state.
If nothing is passed, it will show nothing.
This property is only visible when used inside a Grid Layout component.

headerText.description:
Header / primary text for none image state.
If nothing is passed, it will show by default 'No image available'.
This property is only visible when used inside a Grid Layout component.

shape.description: Circular will only apply on square images.

dataRecord.description: Holds the data for where to find the image.

title: A UI component type that holds other components.
name: UiSdlImage
